I'm noticing the filename encoding issue with question marks—the zip likely stores names as GBK (CP936) and unzip is misinterpreting them. Since macOS's unzip uses the zip's internal encoding flag rather than the system codepage, I need to either use ditto (which handles this correctly) or switch to Python with zipfile to explicitly decode the GBK names.

Extracting the whole 687MB archive would take too long, and the zsh glob pattern approach is risky. The cleanest solution is to write a Python script that opens the zip, detects and decodes the GBK filenames properly, then extracts only the dylib files from Payload/Aweme.app/Frameworks/ to a dedicated folder like `dylibs/抖音_40.6.0_Plus/` at the project root.

Before extracting, I should check the .gitignore to ensure the dylibs folder won't be pushed to the remote. I also need to verify what the 巨魔商店 (TrollStore) IPA actually contains — it's likely a sideloaded Douyin app with injected tweaks like DYKiller, plus various plugins for login repair, ad blocking, 120hz refresh rate, and dock customization.

Let me examine the imports table and list the frameworks directory contents to understand what each plugin does, then extract the dylibs and identify them using `otool -L` and strings analysis.
{
  "type": "tool-call",
  "id": "call_00_tSZB5Ci9zaXHOiWX4YXW8626",
  "name": "run_code",
  "arguments": "{\"code\": \"await tools.write({ file_path: \\\".work/extract_plugins.py\\\", content: `import os, sys, zipfile, shutil\\n\\nIPA = \\\"抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店.ipa\\\"\\nOUT = sys.argv[1]\\n\\nzf = zipfile.ZipFile(IPA)\\ntargets = []\\nfor info in zf.infolist():\\n    raw = info.orig_filename\\n    name = raw\\n    if info.flag_bits & 0x800:\\n        name = raw\\n    else:\\n        try:\\n            name = raw.encode(\\\"cp437\\\").decode(\\\"gbk\\\")\\n        except Exception:\\n            name = raw\\n    if not name.startswith(\\\"Payload/Aweme.app/\\\"):\\n        continue\\n    if name.count(\\\"/\\\") <= 3 and (\\\"/Frameworks/\\\" in name or \\\"/PlugIns/\\\" in name):\\n        base = name.rstrip(\\\"/\\\").split(\\\"/\\\")[-1]\\n        if base.endswith(\\\".dylib\\\") or base.endswith(\\\".framework\\\") or name.endswith(\\\".appex/\\\"):\\n            targets.append((info, name, base))\\n\\nfor info, name, base in sorted(targets, key=lambda x: x[1]):\\n    is_dir = info.is_dir() or name.endswith(\\\"/\\\")\\n    if is_dir:\\n        continue\\n    rel = name.replace(\\\"Payload/Aweme.app/\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n    dst = os.path.join(OUT, rel)\\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)\\n    with zf.open(info) as src, open(dst, \\\"wb\\\") as f:\\n        shutil.copyfileobj(src, f)\\n    print(\\\"extracted\\\", rel, info.file_size)\\n`, description: \\\"Write extraction script\\\" });\\n\\nconst r = await tools.bash({ command: \\\"mkdir -p '抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店_plugins' && python3 .work/extract_plugins.py '抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店_plugins' 2>&1 | tail -40\\\", description: \\\"Extract plugin dylibs from IPA\\\" });\\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground' ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\", \"description\": \"Extract dylib plugins from IPA\"}"
}

I need to identify what each dylib does by checking their dependencies with otool and extracting strings from the embedded Info.plist or bundle info. I'll also verify the Mach-O architecture and code signing status, then organize everything into a detailed inventory.

Since this is TrollStore, the app is likely signed with ad-hoc signatures, but I should still inspect the LC_LOAD_DYLIB entries to see what each plugin links against—especially whether they load libsubstrate or libhooker for the tweaks. Let me batch process the otool output for all the dylibs.

}

{

  "arguments": "{\"code\": \"await tools.write({ file_path: \\\".work/inventory_plugins.py\\\", content: `import os, re, subprocess, json, sys\\n\\nD = \\\"抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店_plugins/Frameworks\\\"\\nout = []\\nfor name in sorted(os.listdir(D)):\\n    p = os.path.join(D, name)\\n    if not name.endswith(\\\".dylib\\\"):\\n        continue\\n    arch = subprocess.run([\\\"lipo\\\", \\\"-archs\\\", p], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()\\n    nm = subprocess.run([\\\"nm\\\", \\\"-arch\\\", arch.split()[0], \\\"-gU\\\", p], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout\\n    classes = sorted(set(m.split(\\\"_OBJC_CLASS_$_\\\")[-1] for m in re.findall(r\\\"_OBJC_CLASS_\\\\\\\\$_\\\\\\\\S+\\\", nm)))\\n    cats = sorted(set(m.split(\\\"_OBJC_CATEGORY_\\\")[-1] for m in re.findall(r\\\"_OBJC_CATEGORY_\\\\\\\\S+\\\", nm)))\\n    out.append({\\\"file\\\": name, \\\"arch\\\": arch, \\\"size\\\": os.path.getsize(p), \\\"classes\\\": classes, \\\"categories\\\": cats[:20]})\\nprint(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))\\n`, description: \\\"Write inventory script\\\" });\\nconst r = await tools.bash({ command: \\\"python3 .work/inventory_plugins.py > .work/plugin_inventory.json 2>&1; head -c 6000 .work/plugin_inventory.json\\\", description: \\\"Build plugin class inventory\\\" });\\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground' ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\", \"description\": \"Extract ObjC classes per plugin\"}"

I'm planning to write a script that searches for bundle identifiers and framework names in the filter plists, then pulls out log prefixes, preference keys, and string patterns to identify what these tweaks are targeting.
{
  "type": "tool-call",
  "id": "call_00_bOAAFUzK5Pm2kATGvIcb3722",
  "name": "run_code",
  "arguments": "{\"code\": \"await tools.write({ file_path: \\\".work/strings_plugins.py\\\", content: `import os, re, subprocess, sys\\n\\nD = \\\"抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店_plugins/Frameworks\\\"\\nskip = {\\\"libsubstrate.dylib\\\"}\\npat = re.compile(r\\\"(Aweme|aweme|DYYY|Yuki|DYKiller|com\\\\\\\\.ss\\\\\\\\.android|douyin|抖音|LCD|LCA|TouchVis|CAHighFPS|PleaseDontStop|AutoMessage|AppBadge|MyDock|AWECA)\\\", re.I)\\n\\nfor name in sorted(os.listdir(D)):\\n    if not name.endswith(\\\".dylib\\\") or name in skip:\\n        continue\\n    p = os.path.join(D, name)\\n    arch = subprocess.run([\\\"lipo\\\", \\\"-archs\\\", p], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()[0]\\n    s = subprocess.run([\\\"strings\\\", \\\"-arch\\\", arch, \\\"-n\\\", \\\"6\\\", p], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()\\n    uniq = []\\n    seen = set()\\n    for line in s:\\n        line = line.strip()\\n        if not line or line in seen: continue\\n        seen.add(line)\\n        if pat.search(line):\\n            uniq.append(line)\\n    print(\\\"=====\\\", name, len(uniq))\\n    for line in uniq[:60]:\\n        print(\\\"   \\\", line[:160])\\n`, description: \\\"Write strings highlight script\\\" });\\nconst r = await tools.bash({ command: \\\"python3 .work/strings_plugins.py > .work/plugin_strings.txt 2>&1; wc -l .work/plugin_strings.txt; sed -n '1,120p' .work/plugin_strings.txt\\\", description: \\\"Grep identifying strings in plugins\\\" });\\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground' ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\", \"description\": \"Extract identifying strings per plugin\"}"

Writing a script to inspect the IPA's Mach-O load commands...
{

  "arguments": "{\"code\": \"await tools.write({ file_path: \\\".work/macho_scan.py\\\", content: `import re, zipfile, sys\\n\\nIPA = \\\"抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店.ipa\\\"\\nzf = zipfile.ZipFile(IPA)\\nnames = {}\\nfor info in zf.infolist():\\n    raw = info.orig_filename\\n    name = raw\\n    if not (info.flag_bits & 0x800):\\n        try: name = raw.encode(\\\"cp437\\\").decode(\\\"gbk\\\")\\n        except Exception: pass\\n    names[name] = info\\n\\nexe = \\\"Payload/Aweme.app/Aweme\\\"\\ndata = zf.open(names[exe]).read(6_000_000)\\nprint(\\\"executable leading bytes scanned:\\\", len(data))\\nfor m in re.finditer(rb\\\"@(?:rpath|loader_path|executable_path)/[\\\\\\\\w./-]{3,80}\\\", data):\\n    print(\\\"RPATH-LIT\\\", m.group().decode(\\\"utf-8\\\", \\\"replace\\\"))\\nprint(\\\"---- dylib-looking names ----\\\")\\nfor m in re.finditer(rb\\\"[A-Za-z0-9_\\\\\\\\-.]{2,60}\\\\\\\\.dylib\\\", data):\\n    s = m.group().decode(\\\"utf-8\\\", \\\"replace\\\")\\n    print(s)\\n`, description: \\\"Write Mach-O literal scan script\\\" });\\nconst r = await tools.bash({ command: \\\"python3 .work/macho_scan.py 2>&1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -60\\\", description: \\\"Scan main executable for dylib references\\\" });\\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground' ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\", \"description\": \"Scan main binary for injected dylib refs\"}"

The main executable loads LoadControl.dylib, which acts as the plugin loader and then dynamically loads the other dylibs via LC_LOAD_DYLIB or dlopen based on configuration. I need to check LoadControl's strings to identify the dylib filenames and plugin registry it contains.

  "name": "run_code",
  "arguments": "{\"code\": \"await tools.write({ file_path: \\\".work/lc_strings.py\\\", content: `import re, subprocess\\np = \\\"抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店_plugins/Frameworks/LoadControl.dylib\\\"\\ns = subprocess.run([\\\"strings\\\",\\\"-arch\\\",\\\"arm64\\\",\\\"-n\\\",\\\"4\\\",p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()\\nseen=set()\\npat = re.compile(r\\\"(\\\\\\\\.dylib|plugin|Plugin|\\\\\\\\.plist|load|Load|LC[A-Z]|ellekit|substrate|insert|hook|AutoMessage|DYYY|Yuki|DYKiller|120hz|AppBadge|MyDock|TouchVis|PleaseDont|SJJ|AWEC)\\\", re.I)\\nfor l in s:\\n    l=l.strip()\\n    if len(l)<4 or l in seen: continue\\n    if pat.search(l):\\n        seen.add(l); print(l[:160])\\n`, description: \\\"Write LoadControl strings script\\\" });\\nconst r = await tools.bash({ command: \\\"python3 .work/lc_strings.py > .work/lc_strings.txt 2>&1; wc -l .work/lc_strings.txt; grep -iE '\\\\\\\\.dylib|\\\\\\\\.plist|plugin' .work/lc_strings.txt | head -60\\\", description: \\\"Extract plugin loader references\\\" });\\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground' ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\", \"description\": \"Extract LoadControl plugin references\"}"

LoadControl serves as the plugin manager that auto-discovers and loads dylibs from the Frameworks directory, so it doesn't need a hardcoded list. Now I'm putting together the final deliverable with a structured directory layout and an index file documenting each plugin—extracting metadata from the Mach-O headers like bundle IDs and minimum OS versions to build out the inventory.
{
  "type": "tool-call",
  "id": "call_00_ZMdNXPpuejBwTuODzHrE4668",
  "name": "run_code",
  "arguments": "{\"code\": \"await tools.write({ file_path: \\\".work/meta_plugins.py\\\", content: `import os, re, subprocess, json, hashlib\\n\\nD = \\\"抖音_40.6.0_Plus@巨魔商店_plugins/Frameworks\\\"\\nrows=[]\\nfor name in sorted(os.listdir(D)):\\n    p=os.path.join(D,name)\\n    if not name.endswith(\\\".dylib\\\"): continue\\n    archs=subprocess.run([\\\"lipo\\\",\\\"-archs\\\",p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()\\n    a=archs.split()[0]\\n    hdr=subprocess.run([\\\"otool\\\",\\\"-arch\\\",a,\\\"-l\\\",p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout\\n    install=None; minos=None\\n    for line in hdr.splitlines():\\n        t=line.strip()\\n        if t.startswith(\\\"name \\\") and install is None and \\\"cmd LC_ID_DYLIB\\\" in hdr:\\n            pass\\n    m=re.findall(r\\\"cmd LC_BUILD_VERSION.*?minos (\\\\\\\\S+)\\\", hdr, re.S)\\n    minos = m[0] if m else None\\n    m2=re.findall(r\\\"name (@\\\\\\\\S+|\\\\\\\\.\\\\\\\\S+|\\\\\\\\.\\\\\\\\./\\\\\\\\S+|/\\\\\\\\S+) \\\\\\\\(offset\\\", hdr)\\n    inst = m2[0] if m2 else None\\n    cs=subprocess.run([\\\"codesign\\\",\\\"-dv\\\",p],capture_output=True,text=True)\\n    ents=\\\"adhoc\\\" if \\\"adhoc\\\" in (cs.stderr+cs.stdout) else \\\"unsigned/other\\\"\\n    h=hashlib.sha256(open(p,\\\"rb\\\").read()).hexdigest()\\n    rows.append({\\\"file\\\":name,\\\"size\\\":os.path.getsize(p),\\\"archs\\\":archs,\\\"minos\\\":minos,\\\"install_name\\\":inst,\\\"code\\\":ents,\\\"sha256\\\":h})\\nprint(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1))\\n`, description: \\\"Write metadata script\\\" });\\nconst r = await tools.bash({ command: \\\"python3 .work/meta_plugins.py\\\", description: \\\"Collect per-plugin metadata\\\" });\\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground' ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\", \"description\": \"Collect plugin metadata for report\"}"
}

## 使用方式

1. 单插件调试：把对应 \`.dylib\` 放进 \`Payload/Aweme.app/Frameworks/\`，在主程序 Mach-O 的 \`LC_LOAD_DYLIB\` 中加一条 \`@executable_path/Frameworks/<名字>.dylib\`，用 TrollStore 或 ldid 重新签名安装。
2. 依赖关系：\`120hz\`、\`AppBadge_顶部药丸\`、\`DYKiller\`、\`MyDock_键盘按钮\`、\`录屏触摸轨迹\`、\`请别暂停音乐_2.3.1\`、\`SJJAwemeLoginRepair\`、\`LoadControl\` 通过 \`@loader_path/libsubstrate.dylib\` 解析，必须与 \`libsubstrate.dylib\` 放在同一 \`Frameworks\` 目录。
3. 只注入 \`LoadControl.dylib\` 时，它会在启动时扫描 Frameworks 自动接管其余插件的加载与崩溃隔离，无需逐个改主程序 load command。

rab = json.load(open("yuki_classes.json"))["classes"]
lines = open("yuki_ov.txt").read().splitlines()

# collect unique type encodings per class+selector, and properties per class

cur = None; mode = None; meta = False; last = None; inst_size = {}

for line in lines:
    m = re.match(r"^[0-9a-f]{16} 0x[0-9a-f]+ _OBJC_CLASS_\\$_(\\w+)$", line)
    if m:
        cur = m.group(1); mode = None; meta = False; last = None; continue
    if cur is None: continue
    if line.strip() == "Meta Class": meta = True; mode = None; last = None; continue
    mi = re.match(r"^\\s+instanceSize\\s+(\\d+)", line)
    if mi: inst_size[cur] = int(mi.group(1)); continue
    if re.match(r"^\\s+baseMethods ", line): mode = "m"; last = None; continue
    if re.match(r"^\\s+baseProperties ", line): mode = "p"; last = None; continue
    if re.match(r"^\\s+baseProtocols ", line) or re.match(r"^\\s+weakIvarLayout ", line): mode = None; last = None; continue
    if re.match(r"^\\s+ivars 0x", line): mode = "i"; last = None; continue
    mn = re.match(r"^\\s+name\\s+0x[0-9a-f]+ ", line)

        # actual name text is after address, may include (0xADDR) then name
        tail = line.split("name", 1)[1].strip()          # "0x4bf50 (0x3a5) setRecalled:"

        elif mode == "p": props[cur].append(last)
        elif mode == "i": ivars[cur].append(last)

## 2. Hook 安装机制

原始 dylib 不调用 \`MSHookMessageEx\`，自己实现了一个 hook 函数 \`0x65d8\`：

\`\`\`c
void hookFn(Class cls, SEL sel, IMP replacement, IMP *slot) {
    for (Class c = cls; c; c = class_getSuperclass(c)) {
        unsigned int count = 0;
        Method *methods = class_copyMethodList(c, &count);
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (method_getName(methods[i]) != sel) continue;
            if (c == cls) {
                *slot = method_setImplementation(methods[i], replacement);
            } else {
                *slot = method_getImplementation(methods[i]);
                class_addMethod(cls, sel, replacement, method_getTypeEncoding(methods[i]));
            }
            free(methods);
            return;
        }
        free(methods);
    }
}
\`\`\`

要点：

1. 先在本类找方法，找到就 \`method_setImplementation\` 并把原实现写回调用方的槽位；
2. 本类没有、父类有时，取父类实现写入槽位，再用 \`class_addMethod\` 把替换实现挂到子类；
3. 槽位位于 \`__DATA_CONST.__const\`，hook 体内用 \`ldr x8, [x8, off]; blraaz x8\` 调用原实现；
4. 全部 hook 在构造函数里一次性安装，没有开关判断——开关判断放在 hook 体内部，
   关闭时直接走原实现。

这就是 Logos 里 \`%hook\` + \`%orig\` 的等价物，因此重建工程用 Logos 表达同一套逻辑。

## 5. 主要 hook 的语义

### 5.1 防撤回

\`TIMXOMessage.setRecalled:\`（原实现 0x66d0）被替换为：

\`\`\`c
- (void)setRecalled:(BOOL)recalled {
    if (!recalled || !YukiUtils.isFeatureEnabled(kYukiPreventRecall)) { %orig; return; }
    objc_setAssociatedObject(self, key, @YES, OBJC_ASSOCIATION_RETAIN_NONATOMIC);
    [NSNotificationCenter.defaultCenter postNotificationName:kYukiRecallMessageNotification object:self];
}
\`\`\`

原实现内会走 \`TIMPushMessage\`/内容擦除路径，替换后完全不调用原实现，
消息体因此保留；\`content\` 的 hook 在标记存在时返回原内容。

### 5.2 已读回执抑制

\`TIMXMessageMarkAsReadOperator\` 上挂 \`markConversationAsRead:tillPullIndex:tillBadgeCount:tillMuteReadBadgeCountInfos:sendToServer:completion:\`，
进入函数后调用 \`_YukiReadReceiptShouldSuppressForConversation\`（目标列表来自 \`_YukiReadReceiptSavedTargets\`），
命中则把 \`sendToServer\` 改成 NO。

### 5.3 阅后即焚

\`AWEIMWatchOnceMessageManager.isReadingWatchOnceMessage:\` 固定返回 YES，
\`watchOnceMediaLoopTimes\` 返回 0xFFFFFFFF，\`AWEIMWatchOnceDataManager\` 的已消费标记直接 return，
三个点配合让阅后即焚消息永远不会被销毁。

### 5.4 在线状态

\`AWEIMActiveUserInfo.canShowActiveStatus\`、\`AWEIMActiveUserManager.canPullFriendActiveStatus\`、
\`AWEIMActiveUserUploader.checkEnableServerUploadActiveStatus\` 等在开关打开时返回 NO，
\`AWEIMActiveUserNetwork.updateUserActiveStatusWithEntrance:...\` 直接 return。

### 5.5 设置页接入

\`AWESettingBaseViewController.useCardUIStyle\` 返回 YES（卡片样式），
\`AWESettingsViewModel.viewModel\` 取原 viewModel，为空时用关联对象兜底，
再把 \`YukiSettingsUtils\` 构造的分组追加进 \`sectionDataArray\`。

## 逆向得到的关键事实

**注入机制**：原 dylib 不调用 `MSHookMessageEx`，自带一个 hook 函数（`0x65d8`）：

```c
void hookFn(Class cls, SEL sel, IMP replacement, IMP *slot) {
    // 沿类与父类链找方法；本类命中走 method_setImplementation，
    // 父类命中用 class_addMethod 挂到子类；原实现写回 slot
}
```

构造函数由 `__init_offsets` 声明两个：`0x4bc4`（消息层全部 hook）与 `0x113d0`（设置页 2 个 hook）。共 100 个安装点、85 个带替换实现，全部一次性安装，开关判断在 hook 体内部——这就是 Logos `%hook` + `%orig` 的等价物。

**功能开关**：15 组，全部走 `[NSUserDefaults standardUserDefaults] boolForKey:`，读之前先过 `YukiUsageNoticeAccepted` 门控。例如 `YukiPreventRecall`、`YukiSwipeToQuote`、`YukiDisablePostMarkAsRead`、`YukiPreventWatchOnceDestroy`、`YukiEnableAudioShare`、`YukiDisableKeyboardActiveReport`、`YukiEnableLongPressMarkAsRead`、`YukiEnableLongPresQuickSwitchAccount`（原二进制就是这个拼写）、`YukiDisableUpdateOnlineStatus`、`YukiEnableCustomBubbleTheme`。

```objc
- (void)setRecalled:(BOOL)recalled {
    if (!recalled || !YukiFeature(kYukiPreventRecall)) { %orig; return; }
    objc_setAssociatedObject(self, key, @YES, OBJC_ASSOCIATION_RETAIN_NONATOMIC);
    ...postNotificationName:kYukiRecallMessageNotification...
}
```

因为完全不调用 `%orig`，原实现的“擦除内容”路径不会执行，消息体保留。

## 还原程度

hook 层与工具类是逐条对照反汇编写的；12 个插件类的成员方法体目前是“未还原”占位（签名正确、可编译、返回值按类型给默认值），`YukiAutoMessageManager`、6 个自动消息与已读回执界面、`YukiAboutDialogView` 的内部布局逻辑需要继续逐函数翻译。
